Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent

Interface ModelObserver<T extends Model>

Type Parameters:
T - the model class
public interface ModelObserver<T extends Model>
A set of model event hooks in one class, registered with ModelEvents.observe(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.ModelObserver<? super T>). Every method defaults to doing nothing, or to true for the halting ones, so an observer overrides only the events it cares about.

For each event the model's own hook runs first, then the listeners in registration order. Only a false returned from a halting method halts the operation and the listeners after it. An exception thrown here propagates to the caller. Observers register on the class entry and are not called while events are muted on the thread.

    • afterCommit

      default boolean afterCommit()
      Tells whether the observer's non-halting methods wait for the commit.

      When true, ModelEvents.observe(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.ModelObserver<? super T>) runs saved, created, updated, deleted, softDeleted, restored and forceDeleted after the outermost commit of the connection that wrote the model, as ModelEvents.afterCommit() does; outside a transaction they run at once, and a rolled back write never calls them. The halting methods, retrieved and replicating keep running at their usual place. The answer is read once, when the observer is registered.

      Returns:
      true to defer the non-halting methods; the default is false
